in_hebrew.name: Arica
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Arica הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Ariche', meaning 'ruler, strong one, little lioness'. In Greek mythology, the name Arica is associated with the goddess Artemis, the goddess of the hunt, wilderness, wild animals, the Moon, and chastity.
